# routeros_tool_romon_port (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_tool_romon_port" "port" {
  interface = "ether1"
  comment   = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  cost      = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface or of the interface list this entry matches. The special value `all` matches every interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `cost` (Number) Port cost used when RoMON builds the overlay topology (0..4294967295). A lower cost makes the port more preferred. The default wildcard entry uses `100`.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `forbid` (Boolean) Whether the matched interface is forbidden to participate in the RoMON network.
- `secrets` (String, Sensitive) Comma separated list of secrets used for RoMON message authentication on this port. Overrides the global `/tool/romon` secrets for the matched interfaces.

### Read-Only

- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/tool/romon/port get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_tool_romon_port.port "*1"
```
